spec.text:
Reviews FastMCP activity and proposes **draft fixes**. You decide what ships. Runs while your laptop is awake.

[View runs in Prefect](https://prefect-server.waow.tech/deployments/deployment/b51cf6df-c9df-4239-8d86-846cb52c1ee4)

spec.query: WITH latest AS (SELECT message, attributes, start_timestamp FROM records WHERE service_name = 'fastmcp-triage' AND attributes->>'publish_prs' = 'true' AND message IN ('fastmcp triage started', 'fastmcp triage finished') ORDER BY start_timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT COALESCE((SELECT CASE WHEN message = 'fastmcp triage started' THEN CASE WHEN start_timestamp < now() - INTERVAL '4 hours' THEN 'Run needs checking' ELSE 'Working now' END ELSE CASE attributes->>'status' WHEN 'completed' THEN 'Work completed' WHEN 'noop' THEN 'Nothing new to do' WHEN 'deferred' THEN 'Waiting for plan capacity' WHEN 'degraded' THEN 'Some work needs attention' WHEN 'failed' THEN 'Run failed' ELSE 'Check run details' END END FROM latest), CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM records WHERE service_name = 'fastmcp-triage' AND message = 'fastmcp triage finished' AND attributes->>'publish_prs' = 'false') THEN 'Setup checks only' ELSE 'No live runs in this window' END) AS status

display.name: Live work in this time range

spec.query: SELECT COALESCE(sum((attributes->>'prs')::bigint),0) AS "Draft PRs", COALESCE(sum((attributes->>'triaged')::bigint),0) AS "Reviewed", count(*) FILTER (WHERE attributes->>'status' IN ('failed','degraded')) AS "Problems" FROM records WHERE service_name = 'fastmcp-triage' AND message = 'fastmcp triage finished' AND attributes->>'publish_prs' = 'true'

spec.text:
**Setup checks only** means monitoring has received verification runs, but no live work in this time range.

Live totals exclude checks and dry runs. Monitoring began September 26; earlier results appear in the dated snapshot.

This is run history, not a worker health check. [Check laptop availability](https://prefect-server.waow.tech/work-pools/work-pool/laptop-pool).

**Three draft fixes from five completed runs**, before monitoring was connected:

[**#5291 · Empty tool results**](https://github.com/PrefectHQ/fastmcp/pull/5291)

[**#5293 · Low-rate request limits**](https://github.com/PrefectHQ/fastmcp/pull/5293)

[**#5294 · Image MIME types**](https://github.com/PrefectHQ/fastmcp/pull/5294)

Snapshot from September 26. Open a PR for its current status.

spec.query: SELECT to_char(start_timestamp, '%b %d, %H:%M UTC') AS "When", CASE attributes->>'status' WHEN 'completed' THEN 'Work completed' WHEN 'noop' THEN 'Nothing new' WHEN 'deferred' THEN 'Plan capacity limit' WHEN 'degraded' THEN 'Needs attention' WHEN 'failed' THEN 'Failed' ELSE attributes->>'status' END AS "Result", attributes->>'run_url' AS "Open run" FROM records WHERE service_name = 'fastmcp-triage' AND attributes->>'publish_prs' = 'true' AND message = 'fastmcp triage finished' ORDER BY start_timestamp DESC LIMIT 30

SELECT '#' || (attributes->>'number') AS "Thread", CASE WHEN attributes->>'outcome' = 'skipped' THEN CASE WHEN attributes->>'reason' = 'claimed' THEN 'Already claimed' ELSE 'Closed or already reviewed' END WHEN attributes->>'outcome' = 'blocked' THEN 'Publishing blocked' WHEN attributes->>'outcome' = 'failed' THEN 'Review failed' WHEN COALESCE(attributes->>'pr_url', '') != '' THEN 'Draft PR opened' ELSE 'Reviewed' END AS "Result", COALESCE(NULLIF(attributes->>'pr_url',''), attributes->>'run_url') AS "Open result" FROM records WHERE service_name = 'fastmcp-triage' AND attributes->>'publish_prs' = 'true' AND message = 'fastmcp triage thread' ORDER BY start_timestamp DESC LIMIT 30

SELECT CASE attributes->>'status' WHEN 'completed' THEN 'Work completed' WHEN 'noop' THEN 'Nothing new' WHEN 'deferred' THEN 'Plan capacity limit' WHEN 'degraded' THEN 'Needs attention' WHEN 'failed' THEN 'Failed' ELSE attributes->>'status' END AS "Result", count(*) AS "Checks" FROM records WHERE service_name = 'fastmcp-triage' AND message = 'fastmcp triage finished' AND attributes->>'publish_prs' = 'false' GROUP BY "Result"

SELECT to_char(s.start_timestamp, '%b %d, %H:%M UTC') AS "Started", s.attributes->>'run_url' AS run FROM records s WHERE s.service_name = 'fastmcp-triage' AND s.message = 'fastmcp triage started' AND s.attributes->>'publish_prs' = 'true' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM records f WHERE f.service_name = 'fastmcp-triage' AND f.message = 'fastmcp triage finished' AND f.attributes->>'run_id' = s.attributes->>'run_id') ORDER BY s.start_timestamp DESC LIMIT 100
